message.content:
**Audit — Doctor profile: Health tips section**

1) **Card language consistency** — Yes. The Health tips section uses the same ~16px horizontal margins, rounded-corner bordered card (same radius and hairline border), and bold left-aligned section heading ("Health tips") matching "Clinic hours" and "Practices at." Internal typography is consistent: bold ink title, muted gray meta line — same hierarchy as other cards.

2) **Post rows clarity** — Good. Each row has: rounded cover thumbnail (left), bold title, and a fully labeled meta line "Blog · 1 min read · 15 Nov" with dot separators, plus a right-aligned chevron (›) affordance. No unlabeled bare numbers. Minor note: the "0 visits · 0 patients on Aturseva" line above is contextual, not part of this section, and it is labeled — acceptable, though "0 visits / 0 patients" reads as low-social-proof for a new profile (content concern, not a UI defect).

3) **Truncation / overlap / alignment** — No truncation or overlap. Titles wrap cleanly to two lines; thumbnails are consistently sized and vertically aligned with the title block; chevrons are vertically centered and right-aligned consistently across both rows.

4) **Tone** — Calm and professional: white canvas, ink-black headings/titles, muted gray secondary text, no alarming colors; the black "Book appointment — ₹300" CTA anchors the page without disrupting the tone.

**VERDICT: PASS** — Health tips section is visually consistent with the profile's card system, rows are fully labeled and well-aligned, with no truncation or overlap.
message.reasoning_content: Check card consistency, rows fine, note "0 visits · 0 patients" is outside Health tips but bare numbers labeled—fine. Health tips card matches margins and rounded border. No issues. Pass.
